en.headline: Cathay extends Dubai and Riyadh flight suspension to end of January
en.dek: Passenger services to the two Middle East cities remain cancelled through 31 January 2027 as the carrier continues to monitor the regional situation.
body: Cathay Pacific Airways said on Monday it had extended the suspension of passenger flights to Dubai and Riyadh until 31 January 2027, the third postponement since services were first grounded amid conflict in the Middle East.

The airline said affected travellers would be offered flexibility to rebook, divert or refund their tickets, and that it would continue to monitor developments closely. Cathay Cargo will keep reviewing the timing for any resumption of freighter services to the two cities.
The Hong Kong flag carrier has repeatedly deferred the planned restart of the routes as the situation in the region remains unsettled.

zh.headline: 國泰延長迪拜及利雅得航班停飛至明年1月底
zh.dek: 國泰航空周一宣布，往返阿聯酋迪拜及沙特利雅得的客運航班繼續取消至2027年1月31日，並會繼續密切留意中東局勢。
body: 國泰航空周一表示，因應中東局勢，往返迪拜及利雅得的客運航班停飛期延長至2027年1月31日，屬有關航線自衝突爆發以來第三次延期。
國泰指受影響旅客可重新訂位、改道或退票，公司會繼續密切監察局勢發展。國泰貨運亦會繼續檢討恢復兩地貨機服務的時間。
這是國泰多次押後重啟有關中東航線的最新安排。
